name: nexo-harness
description: Portable engineering harness for AI coding agents.

scripts.verify:core: npm run typecheck && npm run validate && npm test && git diff --check
scripts.validate: npm run validate:repository && npm run validate:schemas && npm run validate:integrity
scripts.test: node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/repository.test.ts tests/release.test.ts tests/integrity.test.ts tests/verify-performance.test.ts tests/architecture.test.ts tests/codex-capability-matrix.test.ts tests/codex-adapter-design.test.ts tests/codex-adapter-core.test.ts tests/codex-agents-renderer.test.ts tests/codex-skill-renderer.test.ts
